title: In SUMMARIZECOLUMNS, ALLSELECTED of the group column gives the total of the groups the query's filter leaves

source.quote: ignoring any filters that might have been applied inside the query, but keeping filters that come from outside
source.supports: the filter of the group being evaluated is removed, the filter that selects Bike and Lock stays

source.quote: it retains all filters explicitly set within the query
source.supports: ALLSELECTED differs from ALL by keeping the query's own filter

derivation: Bike: Sales rows 1, 5, 7 = 100 + 200 + 100 = 400. Lock: rows 4, 6 = 50 + 30 = 80. ALLSELECTED removes the filter of the current product but keeps the selection Bike and Lock: 400 + 80 = 480 on both rows. ALL removes the selection too: 540.
